how_to_apply: Download the official notification and application form from the official website www.jashpur.nic.in.
Fill out the application form carefully in Hindi or English with all required details.
Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph in the designated space on the application form.
Obtain a Demand Draft of Rs. 300/- in favour of Secretary Indian Red Cross Society Jashpur payable at Jashpur.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all required educational, experience, domicile, and identity documents along with the original Demand Draft.

The initial appointment is valid for 1 year and is purely temporary, subject to annual performance evaluation and continuity recommendations. No travel allowance (TA/DA) will be paid to applicants for attending the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: IRCS Jashpur Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of application submission, scrutiny and merit list publication, and a skill test. Candidates must submit their applications at the venue between 09:00 AM and 12:00 PM on 16 October 2026. Based on the scrutiny of submitted applications, a merit list will be published between 12:00 PM and 03:00 PM. Experience certificates from government offices or institutions alone are valid. Up to 5 times the number of vacant posts of candidates will be called for the skill test.

Attach self-attested photocopies of all required educational, experience, domicile, and identity documents along with the original Demand Draft. Report in person at the walk-in venue on 16 October 2026 between 09:00 AM and 12:00 PM for application submission and document verification.
